description:
Don’t tell anyone what you are going to do. 

Just do it so loud they can’t ignore you.
transcript: don't tell people what you're gonna do. Just do it so loud they can't avoid it. So many times in life we can get our feelings hurt by the person you might love the most who doesn't believe in the dream that you have. Don't even judge them anymore. Accept them and go be you. Don't tell them anything. Just do it so loud they can't avoid it.
spoken_hook_0_3s: Don't tell people what you're going to do. Just do it so loud.
first_sentence: don't tell people what you're gonna do.
